name: Holly Jennings
prior_offices: Sheridan County commissioner (listed on the official commissioners page; Sheridan Media reported she was one of three commissioners elected in the November 2026 general election)
background: Holly Jennings is a Sheridan County commissioner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official commissioners page lists her on the board. Sheridan Media reported that she, Christi Haswell, and Jim Schellinger were the three candidates elected to the commission in that election.
